name: decidealot
description: Run local Laya and Von typed decisions through the Decidealot REST or MCP API.

interface.longDescription: Run local Laya and Von models for TypeSafe-compatible choices, scores, and true or false decisions through REST or MCP.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Decidealot to evaluate the supplied state with the specified local model, then report the typed answer and its probabilities without taking an external action.
